prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Tune Your Desktop Pet Voice & Traits", "Select sound effects, voice pitch, and greeting behavior.", "Preview Pet Greeting", "Save Traits & Continue"]
1: ["Building Your Desktop Companion", "Preparing animations, desktop tray integration, and screen interactions.", "Asset Compilation", "Desktop Tray Docking Active"]
2: ["Try Your Desktop Controls Now", "Practice essential tray actions and screen hotkeys before entering your desktop.", "Tray Control Checklist", "Test Summon & Hide"]
3: []
4: ["Preset path takes ~1 minute. Custom studio path takes ~3 minutes.", "Quick Setup: Under 2 Mins"]
5: ["Your pet is initializing graphics shaders and tray controls."]
6: ["Link Account to Save Your Pet", "Guest pets are stored locally and may be lost during app reinstall or updates.", "Sign in with Google or Email to protect pet traits and memories.", "Data Loss Prevention Active"]
7: ["Your Pet Lives in the System Tray", "Click the tray icon anytime to open controls, switch pets, or manage settings."]
8: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Choose between instant adoption or creating a custom pet from scratch.", "Select Onboarding Path"]
9: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Ensure full head visibility and good lighting for accurate 3D pet generation.", "Avoid blurry or dark photos to ensure successful 3D model creation.", "Upload & Build Pet"]
